title: Classifier.train declared band_order defaults and bounded inline FeatureCollection metadata

entry_inventory.interpretation: This wave extends existing API defaults and semantics; name entries are not complete parameter, runtime, numerical or Google compatibility

changes: Shared training_schema resolver for both MD/RF: omitted/null reads only actual root band_order or validated Image.sample v2 origin metadata; explicit non-null overrides and empty lists reject
Exact declared order/class-column inclusion, no first-row inference or automatic class-property removal; backend specs remain explicitly ordered without engine/Java/dependency changes

Inline FC Element.get/set/setMulti/propertyNames and FC-to-FC copyProperties; row-preserving filter/limit/randomColumn/map-to-Feature and static MD classification preserve owned root properties, including empty collections
Metadata traversal and copies independently precharged; finite JSON/depth/property/byte caps, cycles/non-JSON rejection and nested get isolation; no new user-code execution/network path
Example35 and frontend Python/JS syntax docs, independent raw MD means/distances, SDK semantic graph parity, literal CSV actual writer and opaque-property controls
Actual native helper obtains automatic RF spec from official SDK, asserts equality with explicit list before authenticated JVM startup, uses it on actual sampled rows and preserves matching artifacts

actual_trusted_JVM_component.paired_artifacts: Matching tested base/RF JARs/manifests in same directory, including expected base-manifest checksum; genuine authenticated Py4J JavaObject

genuine_failures.correction: Positive schema-order assertion now accompanies the original opaque-model JSON negative control; no capability, budget or fixture reduction

limits.automatic_schema: Only actual declared1..8 unique flat UTF8 names<=256codepoints,noNUL/dot/system:index/.geo. No null/malformed/empty/duplicate/too-wide declaration fallback. Exact original band_order, even a listed classProperty; use explicit inputs to exclude label/auxiliary bands.
limits.metadata: Inline FC root finite JSON only,1000features,10000dictionary properties,depth96,1MB escaped JSON and shared50000 compilation work before traversal/copy. Compound budgets can reject much smaller metadata; scalar/shape/output caps unchanged.
limits.partial_routes: sampleRegions v1 still needs explicit fields; sampled metadata mutations/mixed Element copyProperties unsupported; FC copyProperties requires FC source and destination. merge keeps existing behavior, no metadata-conflict policy; map-toImages stays ImageSequence.
limits.runtime: Existing model/RF/grid/row/cell/wire/work limits unchanged. Runtime training specs already explicit; no new engine algorithm or deployment.

not_supported: Full pinned API/parameters/Google semantics,automatic field guessing,full Google default-output or RNG/model parity
Dynamic sampled metadata setters,automatic v1 sampleRegions inputs,mixed copyProperties,merge metadata conflicts
